NVT Name: FCKeditor Connectors Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
Summary:
Web applications providing wrong configured FCKeditor connectors
  might be prone to an arbitrary-file-upload vulnerability.
Specific Result:
It was possible to detect a connector at:

/cfide/scripts/ajax/FCKeditor/editor/filemanager/connectors/cfm/connector.cfm?Command=GetFolders&Type=File&CurrentFolder=%2F
Impact:
An attacker may leverage this issue to upload arbitrary files to
  the affected system. This can result in arbitrary code execution within the context of the
  vulnerable application.
Solution:
Check the config of this connector and make sure that no
  arbitrary file extensions are allowed for uploading.
